dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

publish.description: The tool's publish argument list, followed by each file of the target's dependentTasksOutputFiles input, none where the target states no such input

preview.description: Arguments the tool's own dry run adds to publish, run under a dry run in place of publish; absent prints publish and runs nothing

credential.description: Environment variable holding the destination's credential, or variables in order of preference any one of which grants it (an OIDC token request beside a registry token), where every one is unset or empty the run publishes nothing, names them, and succeeds

flag.description: Argument the tool takes the credential under, for a tool reading no variable itself

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Publish
description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command where the destination's credential is set and the checked-out commit holds the project's tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, and names the missing variable or tag where it is not; runs through nx release publish, a dry run previewing every project
